installer-gui-script.title: GeLB @VERSION@

choice.title: GeLB @VERSION@
choice.description: The compiler (gelbc), the compile-and-run wrapper (gelb-run), the viewer (gelb-view), all examples, the user tutorial, a private Python and the libraries they need. Installs into ~/gelb (about 400 MB); the last step compiles and runs one example, which takes about half a minute.

choice.title: Set up zsh
choice.description: Adds one PATH line to ~/.zprofile so that gelb-run, gelbc and gelb-view are found in new Terminal windows.

choice.title: Set up bash
choice.description: Adds one PATH line to ~/.bash_profile (or to ~/.profile when that is the file you already use).

choice.title: Set up tcsh
choice.description: Adds one setenv PATH line to ~/.tcshrc (or to ~/.cshrc when that is the file you already use).

choice.title: VS Code extension
choice.description: Installs the GeLB language extension (syntax highlighting, Problems panel, geometry preview) into Visual Studio Code, if it is installed. The settings that point the extension at ~/gelb are written in any case.
